title: "LS-GKM motif-importance analysis"
subtitle: "GkmExplain, TF-MoDISco, and HOCOMOCO14 | held-out chr2 | real genomic backgrounds"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    number_sections: true
    theme: cosmo
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,
                      fig.width=10, fig.height=6, dpi=130)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(gt)
  library(jsonlite)
  library(scales)
  library(tidyr)
})
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size=12) +
            theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), legend.position="bottom"))

task_labels <- c(evn="EVN", svn="SVN", evs="EVS")
task_definitions <- c(
  EVN="Enhancer versus genomic background",
  SVN="Silencer versus genomic background",
  EVS="Enhancer versus silencer"
)
task_colors <- c(EVN="#0072B2", SVN="#D55E00", EVS="#009E73")
sign_colors <- c(negative="#7B3294", positive="#008837")
class_labels <- c(negative="Negative-class sequence", positive="Positive-class sequence")

read_task <- function(task) {
  discovery <- file.path("results", task, "GRCh38", "ls-gkm", "real",
                         "gkmexplain", "through_chrX")
  annotation <- file.path("results", task, "GRCh38", "ls-gkm", "real",
                          "gkmexplain_hocomoco14", "through_chrX")
  discovery_required <- c("metadata.json", "manifest.tsv", "motif_patterns.tsv")
  annotation_required <- c("metadata.json", "pattern_annotations.tsv",
                           "motif_summary.tsv", "logo_manifest.tsv")
  missing <- c(
    file.path(discovery, discovery_required)[
      !file.exists(file.path(discovery, discovery_required))],
    file.path(annotation, annotation_required)[
      !file.exists(file.path(annotation, annotation_required))]
  )
  if (length(missing)) stop(task, " is missing: ", paste(missing, collapse=", "))

  label <- unname(task_labels[[task]])
  manifest <- read.delim(file.path(discovery, "manifest.tsv"),
                         check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  discovered <- read.delim(file.path(discovery, "motif_patterns.tsv"),
                           check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE) |>
    mutate(pattern_name=paste0("pattern_", pattern_index),
           pattern_id=paste(class_name, sign, pattern_name, sep=":"))
  patterns <- read.delim(file.path(annotation, "pattern_annotations.tsv"),
                         check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE) |>
    left_join(
      discovered |>
        select(pattern_id, total_contribution),
      by="pattern_id"
    ) |>
    mutate(Task=.env$label,
           best_match_significant=best_match_significant %in%
             c(TRUE, "True", "TRUE", 1))
  motifs <- read.delim(file.path(annotation, "motif_summary.tsv"),
                       check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE) |>
    mutate(Task=.env$label)
  logos <- read.delim(file.path(annotation, "logo_manifest.tsv"),
                      check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE) |>
    mutate(Task=.env$label,
           image_path=file.path(annotation, png)) |>
    left_join(
      patterns |>
        select(pattern_id, class_name, sign, n_seqlets, representative_gene,
               best_motif, best_tomtom_global_qvalue,
               best_match_significant, total_contribution),
      by="pattern_id"
    )
  list(
    discovery=discovery,
    annotation=annotation,
    discovery_metadata=read_json(file.path(discovery, "metadata.json"),
                                 simplifyVector=TRUE),
    annotation_metadata=read_json(file.path(annotation, "metadata.json"),
                                  simplifyVector=TRUE),
    manifest=manifest,
    patterns=patterns,
    motifs=motifs,
    logos=logos
  )
}

analyses <- setNames(lapply(names(task_labels), read_task), unname(task_labels))
patterns <- bind_rows(lapply(analyses, `[[`, "patterns"))
motifs <- bind_rows(lapply(analyses, `[[`, "motifs"))
logos <- bind_rows(lapply(analyses, `[[`, "logos"))

qc <- bind_rows(lapply(names(analyses), function(task) {
  x <- analyses[[task]]
  manifest <- x$manifest
  tibble(
    Task=task,
    Classification=task_definitions[[task]],
    `Test sequences`=nrow(manifest),
    `Positive sequences`=sum(manifest$class_name == "positive"),
    `Negative sequences`=sum(manifest$class_name == "negative"),
    Patterns=x$annotation_metadata$counts$patterns,
    `Significantly annotated patterns`=
      x$annotation_metadata$counts$significant_patterns,
    Seqlets=sum(x$patterns$n_seqlets),
    `Support vectors`=x$discovery_metadata$model_header$total_sv
  )
}))

logo_gallery <- function(data, n=6) {
  data <- data |>
    filter(best_match_significant) |>
    arrange(desc(n_seqlets), desc(abs(total_contribution))) |>
    slice_head(n=n)
  cards <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(data)), function(i) {
    row <- data[i, , drop=FALSE]
    motif <- ifelse(is.na(row$representative_gene[[1]]) ||
                      row$representative_gene[[1]] == "",
                    row$best_motif[[1]], row$representative_gene[[1]])
    htmltools::tags$figure(
      style="display:block; width:94%; vertical-align:top; margin:1.5% auto 3% auto;",
      htmltools::tags$img(
        src=knitr::image_uri(row$image_path[[1]]),
        style="width:100%; height:auto;"
      ),
      htmltools::tags$figcaption(
        style="font-size:1em; line-height:1.35; text-align:center; margin-top:0.6em;",
        paste0(row$class_name[[1]], " sequence; ", row$sign[[1]],
               " contribution; ", motif, "; ",
               comma(row$n_seqlets[[1]]), " seqlets; global q=",
               scientific(row$best_tomtom_global_qvalue[[1]], digits=2))
      )
    )
  })
  htmltools::tagList(cards)
}

top_motif_plot <- function(task, n=12) {
  data <- motifs |>
    filter(Task == task) |>
    arrange(desc(total_seqlets), minimum_global_qvalue) |>
    slice_head(n=n) |>
    mutate(label=paste0(representative_gene, " (", class_name, ", ", sign, ")"),
           label=factor(label, levels=rev(unique(label))))
  ggplot(data, aes(total_seqlets, label, fill=sign)) +
    geom_col(width=.72) +
    geom_text(aes(label=comma(total_seqlets)), hjust=-.08, size=3.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=sign_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels=comma, expand=expansion(mult=c(0, .18))) +
    labs(title=paste(task, "leading HOCOMOCO motif clusters"),
         subtitle="Ranked by TF-MoDISco seqlets assigned to significantly annotated patterns",
         x="Seqlets", y=NULL, fill="Contribution sign")
}
```

# Scope

This report interprets the final through-chrX LS-GKM models on their held-out
chr2 test sets. GkmExplain assigns a contribution score to every nucleotide,
separately for positive- and negative-class sequences. TF-MoDISco groups
recurrent contribution patterns, and TOMTOM annotates those patterns against
the non-redundant HOCOMOCO v14 CORE clustered motif library.

The report mirrors the structure of the AlphaGenome/Tangermeme report where
the methods provide comparable information: class, contribution sign, motif
prevalence, task specificity, and representative logos. It does **not** equate
LS-GKM contribution magnitudes with AlphaGenome saliency or ablation effects.
No LS-GKM perturbation experiment is included here.

# Quality control

```{r qc-table}
qc |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title="GkmExplain, TF-MoDISco, and annotation coverage") |>
  fmt_integer(columns=c(`Test sequences`, `Positive sequences`,
                        `Negative sequences`, Patterns,
                        `Significantly annotated patterns`, Seqlets,
                        `Support vectors`))
```

TOMTOM significance uses Benjamini–Hochberg correction across every
pattern–motif comparison within a task. A significant match associates a
model-derived pattern with a known motif cluster; it does not establish
transcription-factor occupancy in vivo.

# Contribution-pattern inventory

```{r pattern-inventory, fig.height=6.8}
patterns |>
  count(Task, class_name, sign, wt=n_seqlets, name="Seqlets") |>
  mutate(`Sequence class`=recode(class_name,
                                 negative="Negative class",
                                 positive="Positive class")) |>
  ggplot(aes(`Sequence class`, Seqlets, fill=sign)) +
  geom_col(position="dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~Task, scales="free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=sign_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=comma) +
  labs(title="TF-MoDISco seqlets by task, sequence class, and contribution sign",
       x=NULL, y="Seqlets", fill="Contribution sign") +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title.position="top")) +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=10.5, margin=margin(t=8)),
        legend.position="bottom",
        legend.title=element_text(size=11),
        legend.text=element_text(size=10.5),
        legend.box.margin=margin(t=14),
        plot.margin=margin(10, 12, 18, 12))
```

Positive contribution increases the LS-GKM decision score; negative
contribution decreases it. Sequence class describes where a pattern was
observed, not the direction of its contribution.

# Cross-task motif comparison

```{r cross-task-table}
cross_task <- motifs |>
  group_by(Task, representative_gene) |>
  summarise(
    Seqlets=sum(total_seqlets),
    Patterns=sum(n_patterns),
    `Minimum global q-value`=min(minimum_global_qvalue),
    .groups="drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(representative_gene) |>
  mutate(`Tasks observed`=n_distinct(Task),
         `All-task seqlets`=sum(Seqlets)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(desc(`Tasks observed`), desc(`All-task seqlets`), representative_gene) |>
  filter(`Tasks observed` >= 2) |>
  slice_head(n=30)

cross_task |>
  select(Motif=representative_gene, Task, Seqlets, Patterns,
         `Minimum global q-value`, `Tasks observed`) |>
  gt(groupname_col="Motif") |>
  tab_header(
    title="Leading motif clusters shared across tasks",
    subtitle="Seqlet counts are descriptive and are not normalized across models"
  ) |>
  fmt_integer(columns=c(Seqlets, Patterns, `Tasks observed`)) |>
  fmt_scientific(columns=`Minimum global q-value`, decimals=2)
```

Shared clusters are candidates for common regulatory grammar. Task-restricted
clusters may reflect task-specific sequence features, but differences in
seqlet counts can also arise from model performance, test-set composition,
or TF-MoDISco clustering. Direct numerical comparisons with the AlphaGenome
ablation effects are therefore inappropriate.

# Pattern-level evidence

```{r pattern-scatter}
patterns |>
  filter(best_match_significant) |>
  ggplot(aes(n_seqlets, abs(total_contribution), color=sign,
             shape=class_name)) +
  geom_point(alpha=.72, size=2.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Task, scales="free") +
  scale_color_manual(values=sign_colors) +
  scale_x_log10(labels=comma) +
  labs(title="Pattern recurrence and contribution magnitude",
       subtitle="Each point is one TF-MoDISco pattern with a significant HOCOMOCO match",
       x="Seqlets assigned to pattern (log scale)",
       y="Absolute aggregate contribution", color="Contribution sign",
       shape="Sequence class")
```

This separates two complementary properties: recurrence across sequences and
the aggregate contribution carried by the pattern. A common moderate pattern
and a rare high-contribution pattern can both be biologically informative.

# Reproducibility

```{r provenance}
tibble(
  Item=c("Models", "Evaluation chromosome", "Explanations", "Discovery",
         "Motif database", "Motif annotation", "Multiple testing",
         "Interpretive unit"),
  Value=c(
    "Final through-chrX LS-GKM models for EVN, SVN, and EVS",
    "chr2 held-out test sets",
    "GkmExplain observed-base importance scores",
    "TF-MoDISco-lite run separately by sequence class and contribution sign",
    "HOCOMOCO v14 CORE clustered (648 representative motifs)",
    "TOMTOM against every clustered motif",
    "Benjamini–Hochberg across all pattern–motif comparisons per task",
    "TF-MoDISco patterns and their assigned seqlets"
  )
) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title="Analysis provenance")
```
